paragraphs: The game may show interstitial ads and offer optional rewarded revives. Advertising depends on SDK permission, provider availability, connectivity, age restrictions and your separate advertising choices. A rewarded revive is granted when the ad reports that its reward was earned; requesting or opening an ad alone does not guarantee a reward.

Accepting these documents does not grant every advertising purpose. UMP manages advertising choices separately; you can save partial choices or no grants and reopen advertising management in settings. A refusal, form failure or unavailable ad does not revoke a saved entry confirmation. Watching a rewarded ad is not blanket permission for additional data processing.
